description: This file defines a feature class for listing tags within an ASP.NET Core application using MediatR. It contains a Query record for requesting tag data and a QueryHandler class that retrieves tags from the database asynchronously, returning a TagsEnvelope.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: A request object implementing IRequest that when sent, fetches a collection of tags wrapped in a TagsEnvelope.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the Query request by querying the database context for tags, ordering them, and returning a TagsEnvelope with the list of tag IDs.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves tags from the database, orders them by TagId, and returns a TagsEnvelope containing the list of tag IDs.
